title: 第25章 捅破天三第26章 捅破天四
lines: 正在这时，吴兴，关怡海，刘坤追击而来。看着丹田被废，四肢全无，裤裆带血，眼神空洞的躺在地上的吴峰，几人眼神收缩，好狠的手段！
吴兴，牙根紧咬，但是却明智的没有轻举妄动！对方有二十几人，他们追击萧龙而来，就只有他们三人！实力差距明显！
“我妹妹，关怡芸呢？”关怡海问道“你们又是谁？”
“那个女人跑得太慢了，被我杀了。”弓紫嫣无所谓的道。
此话一出，关怡海顿时大怒，他们兄妹从小便是关系极好，如今得知妹妹已死，怎能不怒？
“你们，去帮助萧家的其他人，这三人就交给我了！”萧羽道。
“主人，你？”赤天歌还想说什么，却被萧羽用眼神制止了。
“大家跟我走！”赤天歌大喝一声，率先冲了出去。
看着赤天歌等人离去，吴兴等人并未阻止！因为眼前戴着白色骷髅面具的人，给他们的感觉很强大，具体有多强，他们确实完全看不出来！至于赤天歌等人那就完全不足为虑了，因为三大家族，此次集结了超过150位的强者，这20几人过去，不过是找死罢了。
萧羽缓缓的抽出了黑铁刀，刀锋指向三人，勾了勾手指，他需要检验一下自己现在的实力。这三人都是灵武境三重，而且都是三大家族中的领军人物，刚好可以作为他的陪练。
“混蛋。”
“找死！”
“该杀！”
吴兴三人大怒，刚才三人不敢动手，那是因为，这面的人多，可是现在这个不知道天高地厚的家伙竟然向他们三人挑衅！
吴兴的武器是一把双钩的奇门武器，这种兵器使用者并不多，但是却是威力巨大，而吴家的家传武技就是钩！
刘坤的武器是一把长剑，关怡海则是一杆长枪！
长枪后发而先至，直指萧羽的面门，长剑横扫萧羽的腰部，双钩则是攻向萧羽的下盘，这三人虽是第一次联手对敌，但是配合的却是紧密！
萧羽一刀挡开长枪，后退一步，让过长剑，反手一刀斜着斩向吴兴。
这是一招敌死我伤的打法，只要吴兴不要命了，萧羽的双腿也就保不住了，可是吴兴愿意赴死吗？答案是否定的，所以吴兴不得不后退。
只要吴兴一退，三人的联击之势就破了！
萧羽趁势追击，直接一刀斩向刘坤，刘坤迅速横剑挡在胸前。但是萧羽的恐怖的肉身之力已经是达到了地武境级别，这势大力沉的一击也不是区区灵武境三重的刘坤可以抵挡了，刘坤被一刀劈飞。
击飞刘坤之后，拉近了萧羽与关怡海的距离，萧羽一脚踢在了关怡海的腋下！
吴兴的反应也不慢！一钩直接斩向萧羽的后背，萧羽仿佛早有预知一般，单手持刀挡在背后。
“当”的一声萧羽却是纹丝未动，这一击像是砍砸了石头上，就算是石头也开裂了。
content_en:
At this moment, Wu Xing, Guan Yihai, and Liu Kun came in pursuit. Seeing Wu Feng lying on the ground with his Dantian destroyed, no limbs, blood on his crotch, and empty eyes, several people's eyes shrank, what a cruel method!
Wu Xing gritted his teeth, but he was wise enough not to act rashly! There were more than twenty people on the other side, and they were chasing Xiao Long, but there were only three of them! The difference in strength is obvious!
"Where is my sister, Guan Yiyun?" Guan Yihai asked, "Who are you?"
"That woman ran too slowly and was killed by me." Gong Ziyan said nonchalantly.
As soon as these words came out, Guan Yihai was furious. The brother and sister had a close relationship since childhood. How could they not be angry now that they learned that their sister was dead?
"You guys, go help the other members of the Xiao family, and leave these three to me!" Xiao Yu said.
"Master, you?" Chi Tiange wanted to say something else, but Xiao Yu stopped him with his eyes.
"Everyone, follow me!" Chi Tiange shouted and rushed out first.
Watching Chi Tiange and others leave, Wu Xing and others did not stop them! Because the person wearing the white skull mask in front of them feels very powerful to them, but they really can't tell how strong it is exactly! As for Chi Tiange and others, there is nothing to worry about, because the three major families have gathered more than 150 strong men this time. These 20 people who went there were just looking for death.
Xiao Yu slowly pulled out the black iron sword, pointed the blade at the three of them, and hooked his fingers. He needed to test his current strength. These three people are all at the third level of the Spiritual Martial Realm, and they are all leaders in the three major families, so they can just be his sparring partners.
"Asshole."
"Seeking death!"
"Deserves to be killed!"
Wu Xing and the other three were furious. The three of them didn't dare to take action just now because there were so many people here, but now this guy who doesn't know how high the sky is is actually challenging the three of them!
Wu Xing's weapon is a double-hook Qimen weapon. There are not many users of this weapon, but it is extremely powerful, and the Wu family's ancestral martial skill is the hook!
Liu Kun's weapon is a long sword, and Guan Yihai's is a long spear!
The spear came first and then, pointing directly at Xiao Yu's face. The long sword swept across Xiao Yu's waist, and the double hooks attacked Xiao Yu's lower body. Although it was the first time for these three to join forces to fight against the enemy, they cooperated closely!
Xiao Yu blocked the spear with a knife, took a step back to let the sword pass, and slashed at Wu Xing diagonally with his backhand knife.
This is a way of killing the enemy and injuring me with one move. As long as Wu Xing dies, Xiao Yu's legs will not be saved. But is Wu Xing willing to die? The answer was no, so Wu Xing had to retreat.
As soon as Wu Xing retreats, the three people's joint attack will be broken!
Xiao Yu took advantage of the situation to pursue him and slashed directly at Liu Kun. Liu Kun quickly blocked his chest with his sword. However, Xiao Yu's terrifying physical strength had already reached the Earth Martial Realm level. This powerful and heavy blow was not something that Liu Kun, who was at the third level of the Ling Martial Realm, could withstand. Liu Kun was slashed away with a knife.
After knocking Liu Kun away, the distance between Xiao Yu and Guan Yihai was shortened. Xiao Yu kicked Guan Yihai under the arm!
Wu Xing’s reaction was not slow either! A hook was directed towards Xiao Yu's back. Xiao Yu seemed to have foreseen it and held the knife behind his back with one hand.
There was a "dang" sound, but Xiao Yu didn't move at all. This blow seemed to hit a stone, and even the stone cracked.
